column12: note
Voy al mercado. Voy a comer (Unit 8): I'm going to eat.
El centro: the historic heart of a town.
Addresses give the colonia: colonia Roma.
Cajero automático: ATM.

column1: # --- u05.l02 ¿Dónde queda? (place). Also new here, rows in core.tsv: cerca, cuadra

column12: ¿Dónde queda?: Where is it? Me queda bien: it fits me.
Lejos de: far from.
Enfrente de: across from.
Atrás de: behind. Mexico prefers it to detrás de.
Al lado de: next to.
A la derecha: on the right.
A la izquierda: on the left.
Estoy perdido: I'm lost.
¿Me ayuda?: Can you help me?
To ask for something is pedir.

column5: to know; to know how to
column12: No sé: I don't know.
No for: busco el metro.
Siga derecho: keep going straight.
Not derecha (right).
Dé vuelta a la derecha: turn right.

column1: # --- u05.l04 En el metro (transport). Also new here, row in core.tsv: boleto

column12: Autobús is for long-distance coaches.
Also el micro. To get off, call out ¡Bajan!

column5: to get on; to get in
to get off; to get out
column12: Me bajo aquí: I'm getting off here.
Llegar a: to get to.

column5: to take; to grab; to catch
column12: Agarrar or tomar el metro. Never coger: it is vulgar in Mexico.
